INSERT INTO tb_temu_aftersales_product (id, parent_aftersales_sn, aftersales_sn, seller_id, channel_id, site, product_sku_id, ext_code, del_flag, create_time, update_time) VALUES
(#{item.id}, #{item.parentAftersalesSn}, #{item.aftersalesSn}, #{item.sellerId}, #{item.channelId}, #{item.site}, #{item.productSkuId}, #{item.extCode}, #{item.delFlag}, #{item.createTime}, #{item.updateTime})
ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE parent_aftersales_sn = VALUES(parent_aftersales_sn), seller_id = VALUES(seller_id), ext_code = COALESCE(VALUES(ext_code), ext_code), update_time = VALUES(update_time)
